name: Athrikus Narassin's Head
summary: At the Tower of Althalaxx, Athrikus Narassin's Head proves the ancient warlock's death. The coven's demonic activity in northern Darkshore has been disrupted.

sections.title: Blight Upon Althalaxx
sections.body: Athrikus Narassin commanded dark sorcerers from the Tower of Althalaxx. The ancient warlock led a coven that practiced fel magic along the Darkshore coast and carried out demonic summonings that threatened the wilderness. Claiming his head breaks the coven's leadership and drives back its immediate foothold in the region, but corruption lingers and will demand future vigilance.

faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin was an ancient, powerful warlock who led the cultists in the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. He directed the coven's demonic rituals from the spire's summit.
Alliance scouts watching the Tower of Althalaxx need proof that the master warlock is dead. His severed head confirms his demise and the strike against the demonic forces.
Athrikus Narassin is at the summit of the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, guarded by his devoted cultists and summoned demons.

faq.q: Does killing him eliminate the demonic threat completely?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin's death strikes hard at the dark ritualists and scatters their current operations, but the demonic forces may regroup. Darkshore will still need defense.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you see Athrikus Narassin's death purge a demonic blight from ancient Kaldorei ruins along Kalimdor's northern shores.
As a Warlock, you know Athrikus's mastery of fel powers made him formidable. His reckless visibility in Althalaxx proved his undoing.
